done_when: Forge runs uv without GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_COMMON_DIR and GIT_INDEX_FILE, so a merge commit in a linked worktree across a pin change keeps the repo non-bare, its index intact and the merge committed, and a test proves it on new and adopted repos
why: Forge's pre-commit hook hands a merge commit to the pinned release through uv with git's hook variables, and uv's own git init then turns the whole repo bare so no git command works
